criteria.deficiency: No patch-specific deficiency. Caveat shared with the reference: Task.finished now depends on finished_time (rich/progress.py:495-497) and add_task is unchanged. A task created already complete (completed >= total via add_task) therefore reports finished == False until its next update or advance, whereas the original reports True.
